'''Commutrans''' was a mass transit system on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. Commutrans transport tubes criss-crossed the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Lola Curich]], and connected it to the neighboring [[Lianna City]], and with almost every other location on the planet. Commutrans were often overcrowded.
